note: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE of the config-correctness ledger: configuration and wiring defects found and fixed during a migration, recorded with the same evidence discipline as the CVE remediation ledger but kept out of remediation-ledger.json because config defects are not CVEs. Id-keyed (CC-nn) so re-recording is idempotent. The operator's ledger is a private record at monitor/private/config-correctness-ledger.json (CW_CONFIG_CORRECTNESS_LEDGER); no runtime code reads it.
